name: DocCheck Basic
description: DocCheck Basic Login page and block
project_description: DocCheck Basic integrates the DocCheck login (basic license, https://access.doccheck.com/ ) so a site can gate pharmaceutical/medical content behind the DocCheck identity system for verified healthcare professionals. It provides a DocCheck login button as both a block ("DocCheck Basic") and a page (/doccheck-login), plus a callback route (/_dc_callback) that DocCheck redirects visitors back to. On successful return the module logs the visitor into a single pre-configured Drupal user account (the "Login as User"); that account's role must be granted view access to the protected content. The module itself sets no permissions and blocks no content — gating is done with ordinary Drupal role/permission and block-visibility configuration on that one shared account. An optional OAuth2 client secret enables server-side verification of the DocCheck authorization code, and an optional IP-based auto-login lets the DocCheck search crawler index protected pages.
